title: Analytics Dashboard
summary: Dashboard with a welcome banner at top-left, four stat pills for transactions, a weekly overview bar chart, total earning card with category breakdown, a radar/polar performance chart, a vertical list of current/total balances with progress indicators, a sales-by-country list with flag icons and progress bars, and a full-width data table showing recent users with columns for name, email, role, and status. Right sidebar shows theme customizer panel.

layout.columns: Mixed: top row has 3 cards (welcome banner + stats, weekly overview, total earning), middle row has performance chart + balance list, bottom row has sales-by-country + user table, each spanning roughly 4-8 columns in a 12-col grid
